architectureDecisions: D1 — DELIVER_SLICE_V1 manifest = { id, repositoryRoot, baseRevision, prompt, tool, backendVerifications, qaVerifications, requiredFiles?, recoveryDir?, maxAttempts?, timeoutMs? }. validateDeliverSlice rejects missing id/repo/40-hex revision/prompt/tool/non-empty backend and qa verification arrays.

D2 — exharness-agent deliver --slice <file> [--command <path>] [--recovery-dir <dir>] reads the manifest, calls runSupervisedBackendWork (BB-100) with mapped AGENT_TASK, then on APPLIED runs QA command verifiers via createLocalCommandVerifier on a fresh read-only checkout of acceptedSha with requireUnchangedTree true.
D3 — QA failure (mutation, revision mismatch, non-zero) yields slice status QA_FAILED with backendSha recorded; Backend EXHAUSTED/TOOL_UNAVAILABLE stops before QA. ACCEPTED requires both stages.

D4 — recoveryDir is passed to BB-101. Killing after Backend ACT and calling deliver again with the same recoveryDir resumes Backend then continues QA on the accepted sha. Missing tool prints TOOL_UNAVAILABLE / SKIPPED NOT_INSTALLED and never ACCEPTED.
D5 — requiredFiles is passed to BB-102 when present. Tests without it still run.
D6 — Docs and report.json include claimBoundary: LOCAL_COMPOSITION_SLICE_NOT_BB069_NOT_BB074.
D7 — Evidence basis: productization probe hasDeliverCommand false; BB-069 objective is a different, blocked first-slice; composition.js does not import agent-tools.
